quest.title: Beat the Clock: 24 Hours
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

talks.objective: Investigate the area near the location Taruka mentioned
Sit down and rest until 20:00 – 22:00 the next day

dialogues.speaker: Taruka
dialogues.text: Oberon and I'll wait here for you to return with more information. Thanks!

dialogues.speaker: Oberon
dialogues.text: Crooo...

dialogues.speaker: Quilla
dialogues.text: Huh? Are you lost, little one?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr! Raaaawr!

dialogues.speaker: Quilla
dialogues.text: How energetic! You look healthy. And there's a special pattern on your horn... Not bad.

dialogues.speaker: Quilla
dialogues.text: Still, why did you all come here together? Did I do a bad job of teaching? That can't be, right?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rooh? Rawrrr!

dialogues.speaker: Quilla
dialogues.text: Huh? What's wrong with it? Did it bring you here?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (I can't let her notice me...)

response.speaker: Quilla
response.text: Why are you making such weird sounds? Are you sick? You seem to be acting strange too. We might need to get you checked out properly.

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Quilla
response.text: Don't be impatient, little one. It'll be your turn soon.

response.speaker: Quilla
response.text: You're up first. Follow me. Do you understand?

response.speaker: Quilla
response.text: Where did you learn to do that? Oh my, do you understand what I'm saying?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: #Just then, you hear the sound of a ruckus outside...\n"Who opened the box... Hey! Let go! Stop fighting over it! Quilla's gonna be mad!"\nThere is no time to find out what has happened. You take advantage of the chaos to escape the camp with {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}...

response.speaker: Quilla
response.text: Where did you learn to do that? Oh my, do you understand what I'm saying?

response.speaker: Quilla
response.text: That's odd — I haven't given you any instructions yet. Do you understand what I'm saying?

talks.objective: Indwell an Iktomisaurus and infiltrate the inner sections of the camp
Eavesdrop on the secret meeting without being noticed

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (Hmm... Paimon can't see clearly from here, but they might spot us if we get closer. It's better to listen from where we are for now.)

dialogues.speaker: Gentle Voice
dialogues.text: We're really happy with the quality of the last batch of goods. We'll be counting on you again this time.

dialogues.speaker: Deep Voice
dialogues.text: Not a problem at all. Just follow the usual protocol?

dialogues.speaker: Gentle Voice
dialogues.text: Yes. We'll need the goods delivered before the air race. Someone's gonna need it.

dialogues.speaker: Deep Voice
dialogues.text: No problem. They should be just about done talking over there too, so let's wrap up and leave.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (Huh? Are they leaving already? That's not what Paimon imagined... Let's head back ourselves. Don't let them catch you!)

talks.objective: Don the perfect disguise and escape!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon was so worried that she broke out in a cold sweat! Good thing she hid, or else that lady would have caught Paimon instead of paying attention to you two Saurians!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You escaped without us...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Wrroo...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Any slower, and this would have become an impossible crime...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Wrroo...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sure, no one can accuse the Iktomisaur... Well, you, but don't say scary stuff like that!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A—Anyway, Paimon was just making adjustments to the plan on the fly! You wouldn't have been able to get away if she hadn't caused a commotion outside.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sure was lucky that the box was filled with Saurus Crackers. The Iktomisaurs swarmed all over them after the box was knocked over. It was pandemonium!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But Paimon didn't see Lamizana outside either, or the people who'd taken part in the transaction earlier. Seems like neither one was Lamizana, though. Their voices sounded different.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Either way, let's tell Taruka what we saw and heard earlier.

dialogues.speaker: Taruka
dialogues.text: #{M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME}! Thank goodness you're safe. I was so worried.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It sure was thrilling! But, uh... But it's a bit hard to describe, so we'll discuss that later...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Taruka what you saw and heard at the camp...

dialogues.speaker: Taruka
dialogues.text: Really? You saw Ms. Quilla, but not Lamizana...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, they mentioned an air race and a transaction. Paimon doesn't know the details, but it sounds like it's for something that will be used during the race.

dialogues.speaker: Taruka
dialogues.text: Ms. Quilla is a traveling merchant who showed up recently. According to Paran, she deals in a wide variety of goods. Maybe Lamizana purchased something dangerous from her...

dialogues.speaker: Taruka
dialogues.text: I see. So he wants to carry out his dangerous plan during the air race!

response.speaker: Taruka
response.text: I don't know... but I'm sure he's plotting something dangerous!

response.speaker: Paran
response.text: #Ah, so this is where you are. Wonderful! You must be {NICKNAME}, right? Lamizana tells me that you've tried out the training course and that you did quite well.

response.speaker: Paran
response.text: Here's the situation. The race is about to begin, but the contestant who was supposed to race against Lliwa has pulled out at the last minute.

response.speaker: Paran
response.text: And well... You know her, Taruka, she's always been extremely competitive, so she won't be happy with winning a freebie...

response.speaker: Taruka
response.text: Then she can pull out too. Which is just as well — I'll go to persuade her to do that right now!

response.speaker: Paran
response.text: W—Wait, we can't do that! She also prepared hard for this race, so isn't the best solution to find someone just as good for her to race against...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Is that why you've come to {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Paran
response.text: Yes. As long as you participate, we'll be sure to compensate you no matter where you end up in the standings...

choices.text: Okay, now you're really looking down on me.

response.speaker: Paran
response.text: Huh? Oh, you're right... Well, if you end up in a top spot, we'll give you the reward for your ranking and a bonus to boot.

response.speaker: Paran
response.text: Thanks for agreeing! You'll receive the invitation letter later. I have some other preparations to make, so I probably won't see you until race day.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Paran leaves, taking Carrewoof with him...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, you agreed because this would give us the chance to investigate up close, right? If anything happens during the race, the contestants would be the first to know.

choices.text: I also have a feeling that things aren't as simple as they seem.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Speaking of which, there was something familiar about Paran's voice. Have we heard it somewhere recently?

response.speaker: Taruka
response.text: He's in charge of all sorts of things here at the flying school. He and Carrewoof are always running around everywhere, so it's actually harder to avoid hearing his voice.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That makes sense! Come to think of it, Paimon seems to have read about something like this in a story...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If someone who blends in with the background commits a crime, people usually won't suspect them because they are so used to their presence.

response.speaker: Taruka
response.text: Hmm... Best not to say that in front of him, though. His family was exiled because some of his family members did something terrible.

response.speaker: Taruka
response.text: Lots of people have been using that as an excuse to make things difficult for him... Maybe that's why he's so strict with himself but so considerate of others.

response.speaker: Taruka
response.text: Although he's quite close to Lamizana, I have to admit he's a pretty nice guy.

choices.text: Is Lamizana some kind of pest?

response.speaker: Taruka
response.text: Even pests are a hundred times cuter than him.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Thanks for telling Paimon that! It would be bad if we hurt him, even if it's by accident. Anyway, about the race...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Taruka, you don't have to worry about your sister. {NICKNAME} will look out for her!

response.speaker: Taruka
response.text: Hmm... I'll be waiting for you guys near the finish line. Lamizana and I should finish first, so I'll watch him like a hawk!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Hrrooo?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #This isn't your time to shine, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}. Just enjoy the show with Paimon this time, alright?

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Wrrah...

choices.text: It looks like he's got it rough.
No, I just want the participation prize...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: C'mon, just play along, even if just to make yourself seem a bit cooler!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, what happened to your ambition!?

choices.text: Really? Looking down on me, is he?

response.speaker: Paran
response.text: No, that's not it! Wait, what would Temach say in this situation... I know! The training course must've held you back!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Lamizana should be <color=#00E1FFFF>deeper within</color> if he really is here, right? After all, he's gonna want this discussion hidden from others!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If only we could <color=#00E1FFFF>sneak in among the Iktomisaurs</color>...

dialogues.speaker: Lliwa
dialogues.text: Ugh, this is trouble...

response.speaker: Lliwa
response.text: Well, I have a little brother who's a lot younger than me. Maybe it's because he's in his rebellious years, but he doesn't get along with anyone...

response.speaker: Lliwa
response.text: Bah, I'll only add to your troubles by telling you about this. Things will probably get better when he grows up!

response.speaker: Lliwa
response.text: It's no trouble. See you around.

dialogues.speaker: Temach
dialogues.text: We still have a few more flying challenges. Details are written on the board. Give 'em a try if you're keen... Of course, there are prizes to be won.

response.speaker: Temach
response.text: Honestly, I have no clue why it's called that. But speaking of Pakpaka... Have you ever heard the story of Kuntur and the evil sorcerer Rumi?

response.speaker: Temach
response.text: The warriors of the tribe were defeated by that wicked mage, and he turned them into Pakpaka... which doesn't sound all that good. Maybe Pakpakas fly very quickly, or something — I don't know.

response.speaker: Temach
response.text: Haha... He's a good fighter, but not necessarily a good teacher. And as an opponent in flying competitions... I guess he's passable?

response.speaker: Temach
response.text: But I mean, why would you come here if you didn't have issues with flying? So, if I were to be too strict... *sigh* Well, it's not like things like this have never happened in the past.

response.speaker: Temach
response.text: That's why I focus on encouraging people nowadays. I'm sure that approach will get results just fine too.

response.speaker: Temach
response.text: See you. You're welcome back any time.

dialogues.speaker: Cisik
dialogues.text: Welcome to Pakpaka Flying School!

response.speaker: Cisik
response.text: We give all cadets the necessary guidance and help they need. Things have changed a lot, you know. Back in the day, students couldn't expect that kind of tender loving care.

response.speaker: Cisik
response.text: But then there was this one time when the coach was a little... strict with their words, and the student in question just happened to have quite a temper... *sigh* Yeah, that's not a fun one to talk about.

response.speaker: Cisik
response.text: Anyway, our teaching policy's been shaken up since then. And I mean, nobody slaps a smiling face, and nobody hates compliments, am I right?

response.speaker: Cisik
response.text: Here's to a pleasant day!

dialogues.speaker: Oberon
dialogues.text: Taruka seems unhappy. What happened...?
